items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: Ms. Cole, Ms. Cole's lawn garden up there on Magnolia Street.

ctx.x: Were there any brass bands or parades or dance bands you remember? No. Yeah, yeah. Most of the time was just string instruments, see? And, well, of all the bands I played with was full bands. Yes. I mean, even before you took up music, do you remember going to any dances or hearing any music? Oh, yes. I used to go to dances. Do you remember which bands you played? Well, practically most all they had the Blazer Way band. They had the Charlie Galloway's band. And they had the Silver Leaf band. Yeah. They used to…
What was this band? Ms. Cole, Ms. Cole's lawn garden up there on Magnolia Street. You mentioned, was that called Blaze Away band? What was that? I never heard of that before.
Yeah, that was a Creole band from downtown. Do you remember anybody in that band? No.
